observations: Looked at assets/panels/03-3.png with Read. The desk top across the lower third is now a cream/off-white counter with a thin light-wood strip along the bottom edge. It no longer reads as the plain tan wood top described in r3.

Compared with page-03.png: 03-1 has a cream top with a wood front strip, 03-2 a cream top, and 03-4 a cream top with a teal front. The 03-3 counter top now matches all three, so 'the same desk' supports the reverse angle set up in 03-2.

Ravi (left) matches main-cast.png: side-parted short black hair, short trimmed beard, square jaw, thick straight brows, light green shirt with chest pocket and rolled sleeves. Eyes closed in a smile with small nod arcs by his head, which fits 'nods with a smile' / 'Yes, please.'

Ravi's hands: both rest on the desk edge (about x 255-400 and 430-530, y 545-615), matching production ravi left/right 'resting on the desk edge'. The watch is on the screen-right wrist, which is his left since he faces the viewer. The dark-brown bag strap runs over his screen-right (left) shoulder, with the bag behind his left forearm. The dark-blue phone lies flat on the desk in front of him (about x 160-310, y 615-665), held by no one.

Meera (right) matches the sheet: round face, large round eyes, high thin brows, side braid over her left shoulder with teal tie, blue kurta with white motifs, small hoop earring. She types with both hands on the keyboard and glances screen-left at the monitor with a gentle smile. The thin silver bangle is on her screen-left wrist (about x 1065, y 515), which is her right wrist. This matches the record.

The monitor is turned toward Ravi and the front of the desk. Its screen shows only two blank pale field blocks. That matches the monitor prop record, and in 03-4 the monitor's back faces the reader, as the record's 'turned back' says.

No readable text, numbers or logos. The pen cup is plain. The only mark on the monitor bezel is a tiny unreadable grey speck at its lower right. No papers or ID cards. Waiting patients are seen from behind, as the reception section describes.
Lettering on page-03.png: 'Yes, please.' sits at top left over the window/plant area, with its tail to Ravi's cheek/ear. It covers no face, hand or prop.
